remarks: This expanded 4-bedroom, 3-bath Cape has been beautifully updated and offers an exceptionally spacious layout perfect for modern living and entertaining. The home features a hugely expanded kitchen with granite counters, a large island, and direct backyard access, plus an oversized first-floor primary bedroom with an ensuite bath. The first floor also includes a generous living room, a dining area, a versatile bedroom/office, and a second full bath. Upstairs, two large bedrooms with ample closets share another full bath, along with a bonus room for added flexibility. The partly finished lower level provides even more space with a rec room, laundry, and abundant storage. Outside, enjoy unparalleled privacy in the tree-lined backyard, screened by massive Emerald Green shrubs. The expansive deck and patio are perfect for summer gatherings. Key locale places you in the middle of everything, just 5 minutes from SONO's top restaurants, 4 minutes to grocery stores and shopping, and with easy access to I-95 and Route 1. Don't miss this stunning, move-in-ready home!
